About

AB — Abituriyentlər Birliyi

AB is a student platform helping Azerbaijani students discover educational opportunities and relevant student news.

What AB publishes

AB can publish competitions, olympiads, scholarships, funded programs, internships, research opportunities, hackathons, university events, educational programs, and student-relevant education news.

Official sources

AB summarizes opportunities for informational purposes. Application requirements, deadlines, and updates should always be confirmed through the official source linked on each opportunity page.
